binary_instance_scope: The q2 enumeration is a coordinate-permutation model, not the admitted odd-field bit supplier. q3 m2 enumerates every actual odd-field basis column. The general trace formula holds for every admitted odd q and all m; m78 counts need no exponential enumeration.
general: For N=(address-alphabet-size)^(2m), one width(w1+w2) residual plus one untouched stream has trace N+N/q^(w1+w2). Two independent-family residuals have trace N/q^w1+N/q^w2. Difference N*(1-q^-w1)*(1-q^-w2)>0. Any address/permutation or linear value-selector conjugation preserves trace.
